annotations.title: News events and what they did to prices

description: Travel disruptions read from the news in the last two weeks (a nationwide ground stop, an air traffic control strike, an airport closure, a storm), and what each did to car hire rates and availability at the airports it touched. Use it for questions like 'what did the FAA ground stop do to rental car prices'. It compares the same pick-up dates in the last sweep before the news with the sweeps after it. An answer of no measurable move is a real finding: say so plainly.

airport.description: Optional IATA code to keep to one airport.

country.description: Optional two-letter country code, e.g. US, GB, FR, AU.
